$comment: 编辑用分块，由 build.py 拼进 request.schema.json。

inspectRequest.description: 按 scope 看文件的一部分。
inspectRequest.descriptionEn: View part of the file according to scope.
inspectRequest.limits: 不要一次要整份文件。不带 scope 只返回名单，不返回单元格。xlsx 公式格的 value 是包里的缓存，没有缓存则为 null，库不算。改内容用 apply，不要把这次看到的树整份送回去当修改。
inspectRequest.limitsEn: Do not request the whole file at once. Without scope the result is only the list, not cells. An xlsx formula cell's value is the cached value in the package; it is null when there is no cache, and the library does not calculate it. To change content, use apply. Do not send the whole tree you just saw back as the edit.

inspectScope.limits: 三种格式的键不能混用。xlsx 看格子要同时给 sheet 和 range。没列出的键不要写。
inspectScope.limitsEn: Do not mix keys from the three formats. To view xlsx cells, give both sheet and range. Do not write keys that are not listed.

createRequest.description: 整包生成一份新文件。目标路径已存在则覆盖。
createRequest.descriptionEn: Generate a whole new file. An existing path is overwritten.
createRequest.limits: 改已有内容用 apply，不要靠 create 覆盖。xlsx 用 workbook，docx 用 document，pptx 用 presentation，三者不要同时写。
createRequest.limitsEn: To change existing content, use apply instead of overwriting with create. xlsx uses workbook, docx uses document, and pptx uses presentation. Do not write all three together.
createRequest.comment: path 必填。xlsx 用 workbook，docx 用 document，pptx 用 presentation，三者不能同时出现。

exportMediaRequest.description: 按 id 把图或嵌入对象的原始字节写到本地。
exportMediaRequest.descriptionEn: Write the original bytes of a picture or an embedded object to a local file, by id.
exportMediaRequest.limits: 不改源文件，字节也不进 inspect 树。
exportMediaRequest.limitsEn: Does not modify the source file, and the bytes are not placed in the inspect tree.
exportMediaRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。

applyRequest.description: 用 id 和 op 改文件里点名的内容。
applyRequest.descriptionEn: Use id and op to change the named content in the file.
applyRequest.limits: 不要把整棵 inspect 树塞进请求。
applyRequest.limitsEn: Do not send the whole inspect tree back as the edit.

exportChartDataRequest.description: 把图表背后的工作簿数据导出。
exportChartDataRequest.descriptionEn: Export the workbook data behind a chart.
exportChartDataRequest.limitsEn: Does not modify the source file and does not evaluate formulas.
exportChartDataRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。

exportChartImageRequest.description: 把 xlsx 簇状柱形图画成 PNG。
exportChartImageRequest.descriptionEn: Draw an xlsx clustered column chart to a PNG.
exportChartImageRequest.limits: 只读。不改源包，像素不进 inspect。只画簇状柱形图，系列用包里已有的缓存。docx 与 pptx 报 InvalidField。其余图报 NotImplemented。宽或高超出 1 到 4096 像素也报 NotImplemented。
exportChartImageRequest.limitsEn: Read only. Does not modify the source package, and pixels do not enter inspect. Only clustered column charts are drawn, using caches already in the package. docx and pptx return InvalidField. Other charts return NotImplemented. Width or height outside 1 to 4096 pixels also returns NotImplemented.
exportChartImageRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。contentType 固定为 image/png。

exportSparklineImageRequest.description: 把 xlsx 一组里的一条折线迷你图画成 PNG。
exportSparklineImageRequest.descriptionEn: Draw one line sparkline in an xlsx group to a PNG.
exportSparklineImageRequest.limits: 只读。不改源包，像素不进 inspect。id 是 sheet:{name}/spark:{n}。一组只能有一条，落点只能是一个格子。只画折线。柱形、盈亏、标记、高低点、首末点、负值、横坐标、日期轴和从右到左报 NotImplemented。数值用包里已有的缓存。docx 与 pptx 报 InvalidField。宽或高超出 1 到 4096 像素也报 NotImplemented。
exportSparklineImageRequest.limitsEn: Read only. Does not modify the source package, and pixels do not enter inspect. id is sheet:{name}/spark:{n}. The group must hold one sparkline, and the location must be one cell. Only the line is drawn. Column, win/loss, markers, high and low points, first and last points, negatives, the axis, a date axis, and right-to-left return NotImplemented. Values come from caches already in the package. docx and pptx return InvalidField. Width or height outside 1 to 4096 pixels also returns NotImplemented.
exportSparklineImageRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。contentType 固定为 image/png。

exportSheetImageRequest.description: 把 xlsx 工作表的已用区域画成 PNG。
exportSheetImageRequest.descriptionEn: Draw an xlsx worksheet's used range to a PNG.
exportSheetImageRequest.limits: 只读。不改源包，像素不进 inspect。id 是 sheet:{名称}。图画 dimension 和格子外框的并集，只有一边时用那一边。像素按 Excel 复制为图片的 100% 格子，不乘工作表缩放。显式列宽用 floor(((256*宽度+floor(128/7))/256)*7)，缺省列 64 像素。行高把磅截成像素。自动行高只认微软雅黑一类字体乘 1.65，以及 Calibri 11 磅为 15 磅。宽高是各格之和再加 1。网格色 E0E0E0。纯色填充盖住格子右缘和下缘。上边和左边的外框保持网格色。公式有缓存时用缓存，没有缓存时用库里的求值。合并单元格用锚点。数据条按最小最大、长度 10% 到 90%。两档或三档色阶按 RGB 混合。筛选按钮 17×17，箭头居中。实线边框认 thin、medium、thick，各 1、2、3 像素，字色、填充和边框认 rgb、主题色和索引色，没写颜色时用黑色。边框只画在写下它的那一格上，不沿合并区扩开，合并区内部的边不画。线以边界为中线，偶数宽度多出的一像素落在格外。线只伸到实际有边的那一端。更粗的线盖住交界。斜线、虚线，以及关掉网格、隐藏行列、渐变填充、压到区域上的图形和其它条件格式报 NotImplemented。宽或高超出 1 到 4096 像素也报 NotImplemented。docx 与 pptx 报 InvalidField。
exportSheetImageRequest.limitsEn: Read only. Does not modify the source package, and pixels do not enter inspect. id is sheet:{name}. The picture is the union of the dimension and the cell bounding box, or whichever one is present. Pixels follow Excel CopyPicture at 100 percent and do not multiply the sheet zoom. An explicit column width uses floor(((256*width+floor(128/7))/256)*7). An omitted column is 64 pixels. Row height truncates points to pixels. Automatic row height only treats CJK faces as 1.65 times the point size, and Calibri 11 pt as 15 pt. Width and height are the sums plus 1. The grid is E0E0E0. Solid fills cover the cell's right and bottom edges. The top and left outer frame stay the grid color. A formula with a cache uses that cache. A formula without a cache uses the library evaluator. A merge uses its anchor. Data bars use min and max, from 10 percent to 90 percent. Two or three color-scale stops mix in RGB. Filter buttons are 17 by 17, with the arrow centered. Solid borders accept thin, medium, and thick, at 1, 2, and 3 pixels. Font, fill, and border colors accept rgb, a theme color, or an indexed color. A missing color is black. A border stays on the cell that has it, is not stretched around a merge, and an edge inside the merge is not drawn. The line is centered on the cell edge. An even width puts the extra pixel outside the cell. A line stops at an end that has no border. A thicker line covers a thinner one on the same edge. Diagonals, dashed lines, grid off, hidden rows or columns, gradient fills, drawings that hit the range, and other conditional formats return NotImplemented. Width or height outside 1 to 4096 pixels also returns NotImplemented. docx and pptx return InvalidField.
exportSheetImageRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。contentType 固定为 image/png。

exportPageImageRequest.description: 把 docx 里没有字的一页画成 PNG。
exportPageImageRequest.descriptionEn: Draw one docx page that has no text to a PNG.
exportPageImageRequest.limits: 只读。不改源包，像素不进 inspect。id 是 page:N，从 1 起。只画单节、空段、Calibri 11 磅、没有页眉页脚的白页。宽高按 w:pgSz，96 dpi，twip×96/1440 四舍五入，要落在 1 到 4096 像素。有字、表格、图、页眉页脚或别的行距报 NotImplemented。xlsx 与 pptx 报 InvalidField。
exportPageImageRequest.limitsEn: Read only. Does not modify the source package, and pixels do not enter inspect. id is page:N, starting at 1. Only a white page with one section, empty paragraphs, Calibri 11 pt, and no header or footer is drawn. Width and height come from w:pgSz at 96 dpi, rounding twip times 96/1440, and must be 1 to 4096 pixels. Text, tables, pictures, headers, footers, or another line spacing return NotImplemented. xlsx and pptx return InvalidField.
exportPageImageRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。contentType 固定为 image/png。

exportSlideImageRequest.description: 把 pptx 一页的纯色页底、PNG 和没有描边的实心矩形画成 PNG。
exportSlideImageRequest.descriptionEn: Draw a pptx slide's solid background, PNG pictures, and solid rectangles without a stroke to a PNG.
exportSlideImageRequest.limits: 只读。不改源包，像素不进 inspect。只画幻灯片自己的不透明纯色页底、没有旋转翻转裁剪的 PNG，以及没有翻转、没有描边的不透明实心矩形，含绕中心转 90 度倍数。后画的盖住先画的，超出页面的部分裁掉。半透明、文字、其它形状和图表不画。组合里的图、视频和音频报 NotImplemented。宽或高超出 1 到 4096 像素也报 NotImplemented。xlsx 与 docx 报 InvalidField。
exportSlideImageRequest.limitsEn: Read only. Does not modify the source package, and pixels do not enter inspect. Only the slide's own opaque solid background, unrotated unflipped uncropped PNG pictures, and opaque solid rectangles without a flip or a stroke are drawn, including quarter turns around the center. Later objects cover earlier ones, and the part outside the page is clipped. Translucent fills, text, other shapes, and charts are not drawn. Pictures inside groups, video, and audio return NotImplemented. Width or height outside 1 to 4096 pixels also returns NotImplemented. xlsx and docx return InvalidField.
exportSlideImageRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。contentType 固定为 image/png。

layoutCheckRequest.description: 只读检查页上形状的几何，不改文件。
layoutCheckRequest.descriptionEn: Check shape geometry on slides without changing the file.
layoutCheckRequest.limits: 不生成图片，不调用 Office，不重排。本期只做 pptx，其余格式报 InvalidField。
layoutCheckRequest.limitsEn: No images, no Office calls, no reflow. Only pptx is supported in this phase; other formats return InvalidField.

helpRequest.descriptionEn: Look up how to fill in an operation.
helpRequest.limits: 先搜再打开。不要猜字段，也不要把别的格式的字段套过来。本工具不支持预览。xlsx 的簇状柱形图可以按 exportChartImage 写成 PNG。xlsx 的折线迷你图可以按 exportSparklineImage 写成 PNG。xlsx 的已用区域可以按 exportSheetImage 写成 PNG。pptx 可以按 exportSlideImage 把页底、PNG、矩形、圆角矩形、椭圆、两色渐变、形状文字、簇状柱形图和纯色单元格的表写成图。画不了的对象让整页失败。docx 没有字的页可以按 exportPageImage 写成 PNG，有字的页还不画。像素不进 inspect。机器上有 Microsoft Office 或 WPS 时，可以自己导出后再查看：Word、Excel，以及 WPS 的 kwps、ket，用 ExportAsFixedFormat 写成 PDF；PowerPoint 和 WPS 的 kwpp 用幻灯片的 Export 写成 PNG。本工具不调用它们。
helpRequest.limitsEn: Search first, then open one operation. Do not guess fields, and do not reuse fields from another format. This tool does not preview a whole page. An xlsx clustered column chart can be written to PNG with exportChartImage. An xlsx line sparkline can be written to PNG with exportSparklineImage. An xlsx used range can be written to PNG with exportSheetImage. A pptx slide's background, PNG pictures, rectangles, rounded rectangles, ellipses, two-stop gradients, shape text, clustered column charts, and solid table cells can be written with exportSlideImage. An object that cannot be drawn fails the slide. Those pixels do not enter inspect. A docx page with no text can be written to PNG with exportPageImage. Pages with text are not drawn yet. If Microsoft Office or WPS is installed, export and then look: Word, Excel, and WPS kwps and ket use ExportAsFixedFormat to write a PDF; PowerPoint and WPS kwpp use the slide Export method to write a PNG. This tool does not call them.
